name: test_add_llm_node_save_pipeline_and_verify_participant
description:
Create a pipeline via the in-chat canvas, add an LLM node,
        verify its YAML, save, close the canvas, and verify the pipeline
        is added as a PIPELINES participant that responds to a message.

        Steps (AFS
        test-specs/chat-interface/l2_pipeline-flow-editor-add-llm-node-save-and-participant_ELITEA-2079.md):
        Setup (not a numbered case step — AFS § Preconditions live
        replication): open the fixture-created conversation, + menu ->
        Pipelines -> + Create New Pipeline, fill Name/Description, Save
        (create-mode), switch to the Flow editor tab.
        1. Verify the Flow Editor is open with only the End node visible
           and the Flow sub-tab active.
        2. Add an LLM node.
        3. Click the Yaml tab.
        4-5. Verify the YAML content.
        6. Click back on the Flow tab.
        7. Click Save; verify the update PUT resolves 201 and a success toast.
        8. Close the canvas; verify it's gone.
        9. Verify the composer chip shows "test-pipeline base" (no "Editing…").
        10. Verify the PIPELINES participant row.
        11. Send "hello"; verify the pipeline responds.

steps.name: Setup — open the fixture-created conversation; + menu -> Pipelines -> + Create New Pipeline; fill Name/Description; Save (create-mode); switch to the Flow editor tab
Step 1 — Verify the Flow Editor is open with only the 'End' node visible and the Flow sub-tab active
Step 2 — Click "+ Add node" and select "LLM"
Step 3 — Click the "Yaml" tab; verify the YAML editor opens
Steps 4-5 — Verify the YAML content: lines 1-4, and input_mapping/task/structured_output/transition
Step 6 — Click back on the Flow tab; verify the visual editor is shown and the LLM node is still present
Step 7 — Click "Save"; verify the update request resolves 201 and a success toast appears
Step 8 — Click the X button to close the canvas panel
Step 9 — Verify the composer chip shows "test-pipeline base" without an "Editing..." status
Step 10 — Verify a "PIPELINES" section appears in the PARTICIPANTS panel with "test-pipeline base" listed
Step 11 — Send "hello"; verify it appears and the pipeline (through its LLM node) generates a response
